links.comparator_used: mHC classifier alone, without RAG-LLM retrieval of analogous cases and textual evidence
links.outcome: Overall diagnostic accuracy and all evaluation metrics in external validation; performance under feature masking
links.effect: Overall accuracy increased from 0.706 ± 0.038 to 0.753 ± 0.032; all evaluation metrics improved; RAG-LLM correction mitigated the performance decline under progressive feature masking, especially under severe sparsity
links.quote: In external validation on a heterogeneous cohort with primary labels, integrating RAG-LLM with the mHC improved all evaluation metrics, increasing overall accuracy from 0.706 ± 0.038 to 0.753 ± 0.032.

links.comparator_used: mHC classifier alone, without retrieval-augmented LLM reasoning
links.outcome: Diagnostic performance under progressive feature masking (missing data)
links.effect: Performance declined with increasing missingness for the mHC alone, whereas RAG-LLM correction mitigated this effect, especially under severe sparsity
links.quote: When the mHC was evaluated under progressive feature masking, performance declined with increasing missingness, whereas RAG-LLM correction mitigated this effect, especially under severe sparsity.
